text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the application to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law for lands at 900 Middlefield Road to permit a mixed use, five-storey apartment building. Staff are currently reviewing the application. It has been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment. Staff will proceed to schedule a community consultation meeting for the application with the Ward Councillor.

Scarborough Community Council directed that: 1. Staff schedule a community consultation meeting for the application located at 900 Middlefield Road together with the Ward Councillor. 2. Staff provide notice for the community consultation meeting to landowners and residents within 120 metres of the application site, and to additional residents, institutions and owners to be determined in consultation with the Ward Councillor, with any additional mailing costs to be borne by the applicant.
